title: OrthoGather: a local platform for orthology-based proteome comparison and Gene Ontology enrichment
description:
A locally hosted web application that integrates orthology inference with Gene Ontology enrichment for comparative proteome analysis. It retrieves reference and non-reference proteomes from UniProt, runs OrthoFinder to infer orthogroups, explores orthogroup composition across species through interactive UpSet plots, and tests Gene Ontology over-representation with GOATOOLS. Every analysis carries a provenance record of the software and database versions behind it.

This release accompanies a manuscript under review. The complete worked example described in the supplementary material is included in the example_analysis/ folder.
